column1: # A value NO case can put to Metal, with the measurement that settles it and the case
# module that holds the finding. This is the option-space axis's counterpart to the items
# axis's "objc2-metal binds no name for them": counted apart from the gap, because a gap is
# work and these are not. The generator FAILS on a row whose value some case did compare,
# and on a row naming a value its type does not have, so the list cannot quietly inflate a
# share. Nothing belongs here for being obscure, out of scope, or merely unbuilt.

no public Metal API answers one: an imageblock binding is MTLImageBlockArgument (tile) or MTLImageBlockDataArgument (fragment) and conforms to none of MTLBinding's four public subprotocols, its members sitting behind structType / imageBlockMasterStructMembers on the private MTLBindingInternal superclass, and MSL rejects a packed pixel type as a buffer pointee ("cannot be used in buffer pointee type"), so there is no second route
